summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release with Helena Global Investment Opportunities 1 Ltd., resolving a default dispute under a $10M senior secured convertible note. Terms include honoring $295,000 in conversion shares, crediting $2.6M digital asset collateral against debt, leaving $1M remaining convertible at default discount, and a leak-out restriction limiting share sales to 10% of 10-day average daily volume. The agreement also includes merger consent for a previously announced business combination. This filing resolves a contractual dispute but does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring.
